attribution.note: Zitron states and endorses the selected proposition in his own words.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves the present financial assessment and revenue figure. The linked reporting supports interpreting the figure as annualized revenue. The surrounding causal and industry-wide assertions are separable.

contract.note: Substantial costs exceeding revenue and dependence on funding are an ordinary financial reading of sustainability. The latest completed quarter is a reasonable reference period for the cited reporting, though supplied by the evaluator.

evidence.note: Contemporary reporting supports a $1.6 billion annualized revenue rate within the selected quarter. It supplies no comparable costs or losses.
Reports a December annualized rate above $2 billion, challenging the numerical component. Imprecise measurement dates prevent reconciliation with e1; higher revenue does not establish sustainability.

Reports Altman's disclosure of continuing losses and anticipated funding needs. It neither quantifies the selected quarter's shortfall nor identifies its accounting basis; the company disclosure is not an independent financial finding.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes a reported $1.6 billion run rate but also supplies a higher December estimate with unresolved timing differences. Loss reporting provides context without establishing the magnitude of the contemporaneous shortfall. Neither substantial financial unsustainability nor near cost coverage is settled.
